prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in after adoption consistently performed poorly across 2 tests and was stopped early due to worsening sign-in rates.
Adding wait-time information on the home screen was helpful across 4 winning tests (rounds 3, 4, 9, and 10), while 2 tests showed no clear effect.
Changes to sign-in copy, sign-in hints, sign-in notifications, choose-path copy, and finish new-flow flows consistently showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.
Evidence remains thin or mixed for categories like adoption copy, adoption redesign, adoption new-flow, choose-path layout, choose-path new-flow, finish hint, finish redesign, and home redesign, where at most 1 test won while others showed no clear effect or performed worse.
Predictions consistently overestimated non-winning tests, predicting positive lifts for changes that yielded no clear effect or performed worse.
Predictions consistently underestimated major winning tests, predicting modest or negative gains for changes that produced large wins.

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] waiting_screen_hardware_check_wait_info: Display hardware acceleration status and desktop readiness wait info on the waiting screen to set user expectations during high render times. (why: The waiting screen (home step) has a long mean duration of 2336s. Past lessons show wait-time info on this screen was helpful in 4 winning tests.)
1: [finish, redesign] home_intro_split_layout_redesign: Redesign the home intro screen into a split layout separating pet onboarding completion status from post-setup care tips. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control or hide the pet post-onboarding. Restructuring this screen improves visibility of post-setup controls.)
2: [adoption, redesign] upload_photos_split_preview_redesign: Redesign the photo upload layout into a split view side-by-side layout with photo dropzone and instant lighting guidance. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failure or wrong visual outputs.)
3: [home, wait_info] waiting_render_time_breakdown_info: Show detailed rendering phase breakdowns with step counters on the waiting screen. (why: Home stage wait time averages 2336s. Giving visual stage feedback reduces drop-offs during prolonged rendering.)
4: [home, notification] waiting_completion_sound_notification: Enable background audio notification chime when pet preparation finishes on the waiting screen. (why: Because users wait a median of 201s (mean 2336s), they frequently switch away; audio alerts draw them back.)
5: [adoption, incentive] adoption_certificate_badge_unlock: Add an official adoption seal badge component onto the adoption certificate screen. (why: Enhances emotional connection before transitioning to the long waiting render stage.)
6: [adoption, hint] upload_photos_lighting_hint: Add an explicit photo lighting hint to the photo upload screen. (why: Addresses user complaints about custom pet generation failing or rendering unexpectedly.)
